title: Deployment Lens prototype review and annotated redlines
creator: Ava Patel
description: Capture and finalize design review outcomes for the new 'Deployment Lens' — an interactive dashboard overlay that surfaces per-deployment health (latency p50/p95, token cost, KV cache hit rate), rollout stage, and quick remediation actions. This ticket covers the stakeholder review cycle, annotated redlines for engineering handoff, prototype updates, and a QA acceptance checklist. Primary goals: 1) reduce on-screen noise while keeping key SLOs visible, 2) define microinteractions for drill-in and quick actions, 3) ensure accessible color semantics and keyboard interaction for the overlay, 4) produce a dev-ready Figma and QA list.
acceptance_criteria: Annotated redlines addressing layout density, information hierarchy, and tooltip content published in Figma v3
Prototype includes entry/exit overlays, keyboard navigation, and state examples for healthy/degraded/retry states
Design handoff bundle (assets, tokens, motion specs, copy) linked and reviewed by ENG-21012
QA checklist signed off by PM and Design and added to the feature branch as a PR checklist
comments: 2026-02-10 @Ava Patel: Initial exploratory prototype shared (Figma link). Raised concern about priority contrast when several metrics degrade simultaneously; suggested a 'focus mode' to surface critical signals.

2026-02-11 @Miguel Santos: Iteration 2 uploaded — reduced row density, introduced compact sparkline + numeric p95. Need engineering estimate from ENG-21012 for expanded microinteractions (hover previews and keyboard focus).
2026-02-12 @Priya Khanna (PM): Stakeholder review notes: prefer fewer micro-interactions on first release to reduce engineering scope; ask for clearly defined fallback when KV cache data is missing.

2026-02-13 @DesignOps: Accessibility pass results: several color combinations don't pass AA at small sizes. Action: update token palette for critical vs informational states; add tooltip contrast variants.
2026-02-14 @Miguel Santos: Decision log — drop animated sparkline prefetch on open to save extra backend calls; use server-side cached sparkline image as compromise to meet latency SLOs.

2026-02-15 @ENG-21012 (comment): Engineering notes — horizontal real estate constrained on mobile; propose collapsing non-critical metrics into an accordion. We need final copy for action labels to estimate keyboard nav scope.

2026-02-16 @Ava Patel: Annotative redlines exported (PDF) and comments applied in Figma. Highlighted three dev-risk areas: 1) 'instant rollback' CTA needs an extra confirmation modal, 2) retry/backoff visual state must show expected ETA, 3) telemetry sampling callouts must include link to analytics dashboard.

2026-02-17 @Miguel Santos: Pushed a handoff checklist to the ticket: assets, color tokens, motion specs, aria notes, keyboard nav map, and acceptance QA steps. Also added link to draft PR for quick UI prototype: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1427

2026-02-18 @Priya Khanna (PM): Quick stakeholder summary: trimmed scope approved for initial launch (no animated prefetch; compact mobile accordion). PM requested a light follow-up ticket for progressive enhancement of sparkline interactions post-launch.

Verify keyboard tab order across overlay controls and close action (Esc)
Test fallback when KV cache metrics are unavailable — verify 'data unavailable' state copy and CTA disabling
Validate color contrast for all status badges at 12px and 14px sizes
Run a quick cross-browser test for overlay stacking and z-index conflicts with console global nav
